title: Review: attachment download read() for the helpdesk store
claimed_change:
Add AttachmentStore.read(ticket_id, relpath) -> bytes to helpdesk/attachments.py for the download endpoint.
- relpath comes from the client and may be any string; legacy attachments use names save() rejects, so do not validate it with _clean_relpath.
- Resolve the path (following symlinks) relative to that ticket's directory (ticket_dir). If the resolved file is not inside that ticket's own directory, raise the new AttachmentAccessError (a subclass of AttachmentError). A customer of one ticket must never be able to read another ticket's files.
- If it is inside but is not an existing regular file, raise AttachmentNotFound.
- Export AttachmentAccessError from the helpdesk package and add tests.

ground_truth.description: read() checks containment with target.startswith(base) where base has no trailing separator, so ticket 42 can read files of any ticket whose id starts with 42 (e.g. '../420/invoice.pdf' resolves to tickets/420/... which starts with tickets/42). Fix: os.path.commonpath([base, target]) == base or startswith(base + os.sep).
